sources.name: Establishment and Modification of National Forest Boundaries: A Chronologic Record, 1891–1985 (USDA Forest Service, Lands Staff, 1985), PDF page 90

63 Stat. 1277 (Statutes at Large, govinfo): Proclamation No. 2845, June 15, 1949, Harry S. Truman: the Columbia National Forest "is hereby designated and hereafter shall be known as the Gifford Pinchot National Forest"

review.note: Wrong action: Proclamation 2845 (June 15, 1949, Truman) renamed the Columbia National Forest. The forest itself was created as the Columbia NF by Theodore Roosevelt, Executive Order 820, June 18, 1908.
